_README: The employer job boards discover.mjs reads. This file is the SHIPPED EXAMPLE; copy it to jobs/sources.json (gitignored) and make the list yours.
tier1 rows are public ATS board APIs: ats is one of greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters; slug is the company's board name on that ATS.
Do not guess slugs: `node scripts/probe-sources.mjs` tries candidate slugs against every ATS and reports which ones answer, and `--verify` re-checks every row here.

tier2_browser_required lists sites this tool cannot fetch (JS-only pages, bot walls). The dashboard shows them under 'Check these yourself' so silence is never mistaken for a quiet day. Each row: name, url, measured_YYYY_MM_DD (what was seen), handling.
